:::{#def-one-se-rule}
#### One-standard-error rule

Given candidate models ordered from least to most flexible,
each with a [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate),
let $m^*$ be the model with the smallest estimate,
and let $\operatorname{SE}_{\text{CV}}(m^*)$ be the [standard error](#def-cv-se) of that estimate.
The **one-standard-error rule** chooses the least flexible model $m$ whose estimate is within one standard error of the smallest:

$$
\cvest{k}(m) \le \cvest{k}(m^*) + \operatorname{SE}_{\text{CV}}(m^*).
$$ {#eq-one-se-rule}

:::
